answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. Like a whisper lost in a vast ocean, individual identities are discarded to prove resource commitment. An attacker must incur a quantifiable financial cost proportional to the desired influence, effectively forcing them to act as a raven scavenging for capital rather than flooding the network with zero-cost malicious nodes.
